sampleSize: About 1,200 eligible attenders and 65 percent response give about 780 respondents; a prevalence near 38 percent would have a 95 percent confidence interval of about plus or minus 3.4 percentage points.
primaryAnalysis: Weighted prevalence of moderate or severe financial toxicity with 95 percent confidence intervals, overall and by group; prevalence ratios from a Poisson model with robust variance.
secondaryAnalysis: Out-of-pocket spending by distance and therapy type.
missingData: Questionnaires with more than two missing items are scored as the instrument manual directs; unit non-response handled by weighting on age, sex and distance.
multiplicity: One primary estimate; group comparisons reported with confidence intervals.
summary: About 780 respondents; prevalence within about 3.4 points.
